scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "GATEWAY,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run prod:gateway" "npm run prod:backend" "npm run prod:frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "GATEWAY,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:mono: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.dev:mono: cd frontend && npm run predev && cd .. && node monolith.js dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../gateway && npm install && cd ../setup && npm install
scripts.release:install: npm install --omit=dev && cd gateway && npm install --omit=dev && cd ../backend && npm install --omit=dev && cd ../frontend && npm install --omit=dev
